form.label: Silent Devices
form.description: Catch hosts that have STOPPED sending — the failure a trap can't tell you about (a hard power-off sends no trap). Absence-of-data heartbeat, RBAC-scoped.

search.query: | tstats latest(_time) as last where index=london_* OR index=berlin_* OR index=loc1_* by host | eval mins=(now()-last)/60 | where mins > $mins$ | stats count
| tstats latest(_time) as last where index=london_* OR index=berlin_* OR index=loc1_* by host | eval mins=(now()-last)/60 | where mins <= $mins$ | stats count

| tstats latest(_time) as last where index=london_* OR index=berlin_* OR index=loc1_* by host | eval mins_since=round((now()-last)/60,1), "Last seen"=strftime(last,"%F %T"), Status=if(mins_since > $mins$,"SILENT","reporting") | lookup dcloud_assets_berlin_lk host OUTPUT asset_name asset_type | lookup dcloud_assets_london_lk host OUTPUT asset_name asset_type | lookup dcloud_assets_loc1_lk host OUTPUT asset_name asset_type | rename host as Host, asset_name as Asset, asset_type as Type, mins_since as "Min since" | table Status Host Asset Type "Last seen" "Min since" | sort - Status "Min since"

html.p: Why this matters: a graceful shutdown often sends an SNMP trap, but a hard power-off, crash, or network cut sends nothing — the device just goes quiet. This panel catches that by absence of data (last event older than the threshold). It's RBAC-scoped: Ben sees only Berlin hosts, Leo only London, Gary all. Turn it into an alert (Save As → Alert) to get notified when a device goes silent.
